title: Juicy Crunchy Egyptian Chicken Kebabs
description: A flavorful and crunchy Egyptian dish featuring garlicky chicken, flambe technique, and a twist of soda water, making it diabetic-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the chicken for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, mix the soda water and chopped parsley in a small bowl.
After the chicken is cooked, brush the soda water mixture onto the chicken.
Sprinkle the sliced almonds over the chicken and flambe with a kitchen torch for 30 seconds.
Serve the chicken kebabs hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
